title: Bayer ships HIV-contaminated hemophilia medicine abroad

tellings.quote: you go just back to the 80s where they knowingly shipped a massive amount of hemophilia medications that were infected with HIV into third world countries.

plain: Brigham Buhler, a guest on Jesse Michels's podcast who talks about the drug industry, says that in the 1980s the drug company Bayer knowingly shipped large amounts of medicine for hemophilia, a condition where blood does not clot properly, that was infected with HIV, the virus that causes AIDS, to poorer countries. He tells it in a conversation about human experiments, as an example of how far big companies would go if true.
